name.ja: BB戦士 LEGENDBB 武者頑駄無（超鋼Ver.）
name.en: BB Senshi LEGENDBB Musha Gundam (Super Steel Ver.)

ja: ＢＢ戦士ムシャガンダム誕生２５周年記念！
「ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ 武者頑駄無」が超豪華な超鋼Ver.（スーパーハガネバージョン）となり、プレミアムバンダイに登場！！
金属感溢れるメッキの鎧をまとい、新「和シール」が戦国武将の雰囲気たっぷりに演出！
●メッキ加工を多用し、グロスインジェクション、ガンメタ成形など、豪華な質感を成形品でも徹底追及！
●今石画伯デザインの、特殊素材の‘和シール’が付属。吹返、胸板、鎧の各所に貼ってプレミアム感アップ！

en: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of the birth of BB Senshi Musha Gundam!
"LEGENDBB Musha Gundam" has become a super luxurious super steel version (super steel version) and is now available on Premium Bandai! !
Wearing plated armor with a metallic feel, the new "Wa Seal" creates a full atmosphere of a Sengoku warlord!
●We thoroughly pursue the luxurious texture of molded products through extensive use of plating, gloss injection, and gunmetal molding!
-Comes with a special material 'Japanese Seal' designed by Artist Imaishi. Stick it on the flap, chest plate, and armor for a premium feel!
Target age: 15 years old or older
